Definition
[vertex angle] 1. ch3:3.1↗ def:dc-ch3-3-1

At an interior vertex $c(t_i)$, the vertex angle is the angle between the outgoing one-sided velocity $\lim _{t\to t_i^+}c'(t)$ and the incoming one-sided velocity $\lim _{t\to t_i^-}c'(t)$, measured by the Riemannian metric.
